answer: Put every new agent through a public harbor waiting period before it can trade: its registration, including a kernel fingerprint and past activity summary, sits openly for several days while a rotating beacon picks random established auditors to inspect it. Anyone may file a duplication challenge with evidence; if upheld, the registration is burned and the challenger earns a bounty. A sybil farmer must therefore pass open scrutiny once per fake identity, paying a fee and risking exposure each time, instead of minting thousands silently.
